blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: У ___ (это масло) прогорклый вкус.
exercises.prompt: This oil has a rancid taste.
exercises.why: «у» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Для ___ (нумерация) глав романа используйте римские цифры.
exercises.prompt: Use Roman numerals to enumerate the chapters of the novel.
exercises.why: «для» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том сделал это без ___ (чья-либо помощь).
exercises.prompt: Tom did that without anybody's help.
exercises.why: «без» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The horse doesn't have horns; the ox and the sheep have horns.
exercises.ru: У ___ нет рогов, у быка и овцы - есть.
exercises.why: «у» + genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom pulled the darts out of the board.
exercises.ru: Том вытащил дротики из доски для ___.
